title: Sketch Offset: a fixed slot (Block) offset 1 mm in, the dimension changed to 2, the ring extruded 10

expect.note: Slot of centre distance L = 30, radius 5; offset 2 in: the same slot with radius 3 (the ends stay half circles, joined smoothly). A(r) = 2*r*L + pi*r^2; ring = A(5) - A(3) = 120 + 16*pi; V = 10*ring; A = 2*ring + (2*L + 2*pi*5)*10 + (2*L + 2*pi*3)*10 = 1440 + 192*pi
